World leaders convene for UN climate talks amid concerns

World leaders have begun discussions at a UN climate conference, with scientists warning that global warming is likely to surpass 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels. Concerns have been raised about the adequacy and pace of actions being taken. Australia, a major fossil fuel producer, is leading the talks, prompting questions about potential conflicts of interest.
